0022600092.text: The Portland Trail Blazers open their 2026-27 season at home against the Phoenix Suns, and neither team has played a game yet this season. Portland will be without Shaedon Sharpe, who is out after knee surgery, while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams, who is out after shoulder surgery, and Luke Kennard, who is day-to-day with a knee injury and a game-time decision. The Trail Blazers lost their 2025-26 season series 1-2, but they won the most recent meeting 92-77 in Phoenix on February 22, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Portland a 60% chance to win.
